[[File:Gail.png|250px|thumb|Gail]] '''Gail''' (Japanese: '''グレース''' ''Grace'') is a minor recurring character who first appeared in the {{aniseries|BW}} episode ''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]''. Nicknamed "The Beautiful Crusher", she appears to be a girl of high class and always uses a fan to cover her face. In ''The Clubsplosion Begins!'', Gail registered for the [[Clubsplosion]] tournament. In ''[[BW071|Search for the Clubultimate!]]'', she battled [[Georgia]] in the first round. Gail eventually lost after her {{p|Druddigon}}'s attacks were directly blocked and evaded by Georgia's {{p|Bisharp}}, who then finished it off with an {{m|Iron Head}}. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |width=68% |trainer=Gail |pkmn=Druddigon |type1=Dragon |img=Gail Druddigon.png |epnum=BW071 |epname=Search for the Clubultimate! |vajp=Unshō Ishizuka |vaen=Marc Thompson |desc={{p|Druddigon}} is Gail's only known Pokémon and battled [[Georgia]]'s {{p|Bisharp}} in the first round of the [[Clubsplosion]]. As a {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon, Druddigon served as a challenge for Georgia. However, Druddigon's Dragon Claw was easily blocked. After its Dragon Tail was dodged, Bisharp stunned it with a {{m|Metal Sound}}, and then defeated it with {{m|Iron Head}}. Druddigon's known moves are {{m|Dragon Claw}} and {{m|Dragon Tail}}.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Gail has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Clubsplosion]] - Top 16 (''[[BW071|Search for the Clubultimate!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{dragon color}}|bordercolor={{dragon color light}} |ja=藤村知可 ''[[Chika Fujimura]]'' |en=Crystal Wilkinson |cs=Eva Spoustová |fi=Susa Saukko |fr_eu=Laetitia Liénart |es_eu=Miriam Valencia}}
